verdict.rationale: Fellow automatically produces suggested AI action items for every meeting. Action items carry assignees and due dates, and they are collected in a queryable list where they can be filtered by assignee, marked complete, or archived. The docs do not say the AI assigns owners from the conversation, and "suggested" implies the user still has to review each item. missing for 10: explicit evidence that owners are auto-extracted from the conversation, documentation of an in-app action-item tracking view beyond the API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
